description: Backup files (docs/m2-design.md section 9): a 64-byte header (integers little-endian), then the database in chunks of 64 KiB (the last holds the rest, 0 to 64 KiB), each sealed with ChaCha20-Poly1305 under HKDF-SHA256(ikm = backupKey, salt = the header's 8-byte salt, info = the ASCII text hsn-backup/1, 32 bytes); chunk i's nonce is four zero bytes then i as 8 bytes big-endian, its associated data the header and one byte, 1 on the last chunk and 0 on the others. Sealing `database` under `header` with `backupKey` must give exactly `file`; opening `file` must give `database`. Each `tamper` file must be refused with `expect`: badMagic, badFormat (format, an unknown flag bit, a nonzero reserved byte, a time past 2^53 − 1), truncated (shorter than the header, or no whole tag after it), decryptFailed (any change the tags catch, chunks reordered, dropped or added), cut (the file ends where a chunk that is not the last ends).

vectors.name: an empty database: one empty chunk
exactly one full chunk (64 KiB): no empty chunk after it
